items.title: Why JPMorgan Chase Fans May Look To ETFs Right Now
items.summary: If you like JPMorgan Chase for its global reach and mix of banking services, owning the stock outright means living with its company specific issues on their own. Simply Wall St points out that heavier long term spending on marketing, technology and artificial intelligence could grow faster than revenue and squeeze profit margins.
